title: Keeping Teams in Sync Explained Simply | Principles of Management Ep 18
description:
Ravi's second Chai Corner opens with a brand new team, and nothing goes right. The new helper waits for orders that never come, the samosas arrive ten minutes after the chai, and customers walk away. Everyone works hard, but not together. In this animated lesson we use his chai stall to understand two functions of management: directing and coordinating.

You will learn what directing means (guiding, instructing and motivating people to reach a goal) and its four elements: supervision, motivation, leadership and communication. Then we see coordinating, which syncs everyone's work so the whole team moves toward one goal, like a conductor keeping an orchestra on the same beat. Ravi plans a simple service timeline so the samosas are ready exactly when the chai is poured, and we see why Koontz and O'Donnell called coordination the essence of management.

This is Episode 18 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
